title: Vesicular Stomatitis Virus as a Platform for Protease Activity Measurements
author: Rauch, Costacurta, et al.

steps.title: Culture HEK 293T cells
steps.instruction: Seed HEK 293T cells in 10‑ or 15‑cm dishes and culture for several days until a sufficient number of cells is obtained for transfection.

steps.title: Transfect cells (TransIT or Ca2PO4)
steps.instruction: One day after seeding, transfect the cells using either TransIT‑LT1/PRO reagents or a calcium‑phosphate (Ca2PO4) protocol; the Ca2PO4 method uses sterile 2.5 M CaCl₂, 2× HEPES/HBS buffer, and 25 mM chloroquine prepared in sterile reaction tubes (1.5‑, 5‑, 15‑, or 50‑ml), mixed by vortexing and briefly incubated in a water bath before addition to the cells.

substeps.instruction: Prepare CaCl₂ solution (2.5 M) and 2× HEPES/HBS buffer in sterile tubes.
Add chloroquine to a final concentration of 25 mM.
Combine the above with DNA plasmids as described for Ca2PO4 transfection.
Vortex the mixture and incubate briefly in a water bath.
Add the transfection mixture to the cells.

steps.title: Infect cells with VSV‑ΔP‑luciferase
steps.instruction: One day after transfection, infect the cells with VSV‑ΔP‑luciferase virus; maintain the infection for up to 3 days (approximately 5 days total from the initial seeding).

steps.title: Harvest and optionally concentrate virus
steps.instruction: Collect the supernatant around day 5; optionally concentrate the virus by layering onto a sucrose cushion and performing overnight centrifugation.

steps.title: Aliquot and freeze virus stocks
steps.instruction: Aliquot the harvested (or concentrated) virus into sterile reaction tubes and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Titrate virus by plaque assay or TCID50
steps.instruction: Determine viral titer either by plaque assay (≈3 days) or by TCID₅₀ (up to a week) and record the readout.
